basic_details.short_information: Update 19 Nov 2026: Applications re-opened - apply online from 23 November 2026 to 16 December 2026. The new notification dated 19-11-2026 changes the vacancies to 21, removes the 3-year practice requirement and sets the preliminary exam for 07-02-2027 (tentative).

content_sections.heading: Kerala High Court Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Civil Judge (Junior Division) - Direct Recruitment: Citizen of India, Degree in Law recognized by the Bar Council of India, Obtained the Law Degree at least one year before the date of the notification (as per the Supreme Court judgment dated 21-08-2026), Not completed 35 years of age on 01-01-2026. The notification sets no minimum period of practice as an Advocate. Civil Judge (Junior Division) - Recruitment by Transfer: Holder of a degree in law recognized by the Bar Council of India, Practiced as an Advocate for a period of not less than three years prior to appointment to feeder category, Not completed 54 years of age as on the last date fixed for closure of application filing process. Minimum 3 years of practice as an Advocate prior to appointment to feeder category. As per the notification, the 3 regular vacancies this time are filled by direct recruitment only.

content_sections.heading: Kerala High Court Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
content_sections.text: Preliminary Examination (Objective Type Screening Test) - 100 multiple choice questions, 2 marks each, 200 marks, 1 mark deducted for each wrong answer, 2.5 hours; on 07-02-2027 (tentative). It is for shortlisting only (ratio 1:10), and its marks do not count in the final merit. Main Examination (Written Examination - 4 papers, 100 marks each, 3 hours each) Viva-Voce - 50 marks; cut-off 40% for General and OBC, 35% for SC/ST and Persons with Benchmark Disabilities Selected candidates become Trainee Judicial Officers. They complete one year of training at the Kerala Judicial Academy, then one year of Law Clerkship, and are paid half the remuneration of a Civil Judge (Junior Division) during this time. Probation is two years.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online from 23-11-2026 on or before 16-12-2026, after completing One Time Registration on the recruitment portal. Candidates who applied under the earlier notification dated 30-03-2026 must submit a fresh application using the same user profile; they need not pay the fee again if it was duly paid. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Kerala High Court to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Kerala High Court Civil Judge recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the Kerala High Court Civil Judge (Junior Division) recruitment is 16-12-2026. Online application starts on 23-11-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree in Law recognized by the Bar Council of India, obtained at least one year before the date of the notification. The notification sets no minimum period of practice as an Advocate.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Civil Judge (Junior Division) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 years, with relaxations available for SC/ST, OBC, and Persons with Benchmark Disabilities as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Civil Judge (Junior Division) post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 21 vacancies for the Civil Judge (Junior Division) post, including Special, NCA, and Regular vacancies.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary in the pay scale of ₹77840 - 136520.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the Kerala High Court Civil Judge recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is Nil for SC/ST/Unemployed Persons with Benchmark Disabilities, and ₹1250/- for all other categories.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Preliminary Examination (Objective Type Screening Test), Main Examination (Written Examination), and Viva-Voce.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided for SC/ST (5 years), OBC (3 years), and Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (10 years).

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply for the Kerala High Court Civil Judge (Junior Division) post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply online through the official Kerala High Court recruitment website by filling out the application form and paying the fee.
